prose.note: README.md must be able to state OpenTelemetry's and Coverlet's own floors, which are netstandard2.0 -- a true sentence naming a foreign framework. The allowance is scoped to ONE file and ONE version so the blast radius is a single document. Widening the rule instead would silently un-catch the bug it was written for.

languageFixture.note: The domain layer is byte-identical across all 24 branches of this family, so any tool-output difference is attributable to the cell variables and nothing else.

expectations.note: A dark tool is a data point, not a failure. But a family in which NOTHING fires cannot distinguish 'correctly detected nothing' from 'the scan never ran', which is why the source-level tools below are the built-in negative control.

tools.reason: Python tokeniser. Class B: own parser, never loads a compiler, so the TFM is irrelevant to it.

Node, tree-sitter C# grammar. Class B, and the sheet's declaration ('C# language-version independent - source similarity, not tied to compiler') is correct. MEASURED, not assumed: @dodona/dolos 2.9.3 fails to install on this host because @dodona/dolos-parsers 1.4.1 needs node-gyp native compilation, which fails under node 22.22.2. That is exit 4 (absent from this host), not exit 3 (cannot run on this family) -- collapsing the two would let a missing binary masquerade as a .NET Framework result.
Python, tree-sitter C# grammar. Class B.

PROPOSED REPAIR, not in the source sheet. The sheet assigns Data Flow to Stryker.NET, a mutation tester that computes no def-use chains. AnalyzeDataFlow is a real Roslyn API that ships in the SDK and yields genuine def/use sets.

MiniCover 3.10.0 declares .NET SDK 8.0/9.0/10.0 only -- verified against its own MiniCover.csproj (<TargetFrameworks>net10.0;net9.0;net8.0</TargetFrameworks>). It is the alternative for 22 metrics and cannot reach any .NET Framework target.

Requires Stryker.NET >= 5.0.0. Measured: 5.0.0 with --test-project tests/OrderKit.Tests: 519 mutants, score 24.09%, mutation-report.json written. Stryker.NET 4.0.0 (the platform catalog pin) aborts with 'Internal error due to compile error' because its bundled Roslyn predates C# 14 (field keyword, null-conditional assignment) used by the byte-identical domain fixture. The platform pin must move to 5.0.0. ai-testable-platform v1.0.5 worker (runner: stryker-net).
ai-testable-platform v1.0.5 has no C# OpenTelemetry runner; opentelemetry_spans_runner is TypeScript-only. Nothing in the corpus can make it fire until the platform registers a C# runner.

NOT A TOOL. The only package of this name anywhere is PyPI `unilyze` 0.2.1, 'Get detailed unicode information about characters and text', last released 2020-07-23. Not on npm. It has no .NET surface of any kind. The source sheet assigns it as the alternative for 34 of the 103 metrics and declares '.NET 8-10, C# 8-14' for it, which is a fabricated capability claim. This runner exits 3 and says so, so the hole is visible rather than invisible.
